evidence_against: SOURCE_EVIDENCE_AND_COUNTERCASE | CONFLICTED (interpretation, not competing estimates of the same endpoint): A1 reports detectable coordination, but the held-out average net result across the reported follower simulations was negative. One comparison was similar to random, and simple co-buy evidence rivaled more complex grouping in some comparisons. That is adverse evidence for turning detection or grouping complexity into economic value. It is not evidence that an adverse-exit risk filter succeeds or fails.

SUPPORTED as limitations of the economic countercase | A1 reports 32 simulations in roughly 88 hours, within one venue/regime and with a dominant team. The packet lacks ownership ground truth, exact intra-second or bundle inclusion, verified fills, and effect-size uncertainty. Incomplete launches, dependence and residual confounding limit inference. A negative reported mean is not proof that every simulation lost; similarity to random in one comparison is not equivalence.

REJECTED as unsupported inferences | Address count is not a verified independent-buyer count. Synchrony, shared infrastructure and a relationship edge do not establish common economic control or misconduct. Product documentation cannot attribute a particular launch to Proxima. None of the supplied evidence supports following coordinated groups.

SOURCE/PROVENANCE DEFECT | The ledger reports that P0 retrieval failed. P1–P4 cannot establish the identity of that deployment. Exact external snapshots are absent, and current protocol documentation cannot establish historical semantics or decision-time data availability. This blocks a faithful replay; it is not an adverse signal result.

SIGNAL/ECONOMIC DEFEAT MODES, not findings | Even with a valid replay, bound width may duplicate known-control concentration or measure feed incompleteness instead of risk. It may also reject legitimate, executable opportunities whose forgone value exceeds prevented losses. These are reasons for a matched falsification test, not claims that either failure occurred.
evidence_for: SOURCE_EVIDENCE_AND_COUNTERCASE | VERIFIED (packet arithmetic only): 200,443 reported launches minus 154,045 reported complete launches equals 46,398 outside the complete set, or 23.15%. This is neither a verified exit-failure rate nor a count of independent observations.

SUPPORTED (P1–P4, provider-reported) | Launch, wallet-management and analytics features, plus version-specific displays for concentration and activity, make address and transaction counts worth questioning as demand proxies. They do not establish actual usage, independent buyers, or misconduct. A grouped display is not evidence of on-chain pooling.

SUPPORTED (method relevance only) | T1/T2 describe useful transaction metadata and versioned curve events. A2/A3 offer negative-control ideas from different market structures, and T3 motivates testing size-dependent costs. None supplies a calibrated launch-screening label, threshold or cost.

EXISTING_OWNER_DEDUP_MATRIX | SUPPORTED as remit, not implementation: S3 already owns entity-adjusted counts and the relationship/control distinction; S4 owns launch trajectory and retention; S1 owns executable entry/exit evidence; S6 owns distribution egress; S2 owns wallet skill, which is outside this contrast; X0 owns disagreement. The Research Lab #1512 lane and original owner #1156 are the supplied routes for the narrow comparison.

EXISTING_OWNER_DEDUP_MATRIX | SUPPORTED as reported overlap risk: Astra #2227 could already cover the Alpha forensics or execution-value question; Navigator/Kompas #2226 overlaps regime context, so no H3 work is warranted here. The packet reports both as pending. Failure to find an indexed paper or index name does not establish novelty.
hypotheses: ONE_PRIMARY_DELTA_OR_NO_BUILD | One conditional H1 test only: does uncertainty about pooling among observable purchase participants reduce adverse-exit screening loss beyond B2 at matched coverage and cost? B3 adds one input, the width of a concentration bound, using the same eligible cohort and knowledge clock as B2. Compare against simple known-control-only aggregation and check whether any apparent gain is explained by source quality. A wide bound means less is known, not that a launch is unsafe. No new retained-demand feature, grouping system, heat index, or build.

UNCERTAINTY_AWARE_TYPED_SCHEMA_AND_MATH | Minimal review schema: opaque launch and snapshot keys, opportunity-set ID, evidence references, venue/schema/source revision and baseline version (strings); event, first-observed, required finality, decision, quote, outcome-due and outcome-observed times (UTC timestamps, nullable where unknown); coverage, evidence class, decision, quote/exit status and censor reason (enums); missing-input flags (set); eligible-unit count (nullable integer); concentration and effective-count bounds (nullable numeric pairs); paper notional, executable value and cost components (nullable decimals with explicit quote currency). Keep B0/B1/B2/B3 decisions distinct. No wallet identifiers in the readout.

UNCERTAINTY_AWARE_TYPED_SCHEMA_AND_MATH | For the same verified purchase-participation units seen by both arms, give each unit one count weight, not a holding or exposure weight. Form feasible partitions P of those units. Pool only where deterministic evidence establishes common control of the relevant position under the as-of protocol semantics. Rule out pooling only where admissible evidence actually excludes it under that definition. Relationship-only evidence may remain in B2 but does not force a merge or prove separation; different keys do not prove independent economic owners. For group share s_g in partition P, C(P) = sum_g s_g². Report [C_min, C_max] over feasible partitions and effective-count bounds [1/C_max, 1/C_min]. B3 adds only W = C_max − C_min. These are conditional bounds, not statistical confidence intervals or beneficiary counts. If the observable cohort is valid but nothing rules out full pooling, C_max = 1 and W is just a transform of the finest-partition concentration. If that information is already in B2, stop rather than test a redundant feature. If unresolved custody, inconsistent constraints or missing source evidence invalidate the unit of analysis, return null with a reason; never assign a participant or a risk label to fill the gap.

PUBLIC_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_AND_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES | Qualify one public Solana bonding-curve program/version and one contiguous era before accessing outcomes. Pin immutable source versions and reconcile creation, trade and migration events against the discoverable launch census, retaining no-trade, failed-launch, stale and delisted cases with explicit states. Verify event ordering, duplicates and gaps, purchase versus transfer decoding, quote denomination, size-specific entry/exit reconstruction, and point-in-time availability. Use one existing eligible clock as primary only if that clock is demonstrably observable; omit unsupported clocks symmetrically. T1/T2 describe candidate records, not coverage or historical availability. If an essential check fails, stop rather than backfill with current data or substitute private or Round 3 evidence.

PUBLIC_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_AND_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES | Synthetic checks only: a shared router, custodian, sponsor or LP does not force pooling; deterministic scoped control can pool units without claiming common ownership; transfers and airdrops are not purchases; legitimate market making, arbitrage and high turnover do not create fake-volume or adverse labels. Missing clocks, stale quotes and unresolved version transitions make the affected evaluation unavailable. Exclude post-cutoff links and revisions from the as-of replay. Keep repeated snapshots and related launch batches together for inference. A refused launch with a verified positive net paper outcome incurs missed-opportunity cost; a verified sized exit failure is adverse; a missing quote, immature observation or censored exit is not a failure label.

MATCHED_PREREGISTRATION_POWER_AND_KILL_CRITERIA | Replay B0 only from exact as-of inputs and decisions; otherwise report it unavailable, not proxied. B1 is age, liquidity, ordinary momentum and raw eligible address count; B2 adds reproducible existing relationship and retention primitives; B3 differs from B2 only by W. Lock the B3–B2 contrast, also require value over the simpler B1 comparator, and report B0 separately if available. Freeze the launch/snapshot universe, clock, qualification coverage, risk budget, paper notional, timing and cost assumptions for all arms. A missing W leaves the B2 decision unchanged in the paired shadow test and is counted as unavailable, not imputed. Report census, eligibility, feature, decision and outcome coverage separately. Assess outcomes for refusals as well as qualifications wherever the common paper replay is valid. Use verified sized exit failure at 24h as the proposed primary endpoint and 72h as a locked secondary check. Failure must be evidenced under the frozen replay assumptions; an invalid feed or absent quote is not proof of inability to sell.

MATCHED_PREREGISTRATION_POWER_AND_KILL_CRITERIA | On common evaluable decisions, report both qualification→refusal and refusal→qualification counts; their sum divided by the paired denominator is decision divergence. Tabulate unavailable and abstaining decisions separately. With adverse outcome as positive, false positives are refusals of non-adverse cases; their opportunity cost is forgone positive net executable paper value where supported. Those refused viable cases are false negatives under the opportunity-positive convention. Risk false negatives are qualifications of verified adverse cases; report their supported adverse loss or frozen research penalty separately, never invented recovery value. For each comparator b, report mean paired loss L_b − L_B3, where L includes the prespecified costs of both errors. Use the same sized round-trip impact, fees, applicable gas/tips/tax, latency and exit restrictions in each arm. Show missing-cost and censoring sensitivity without treating unknown cases as good or bad. Report precision/recall and PR-AUC where supported; use calibration and Brier score only for valid probabilities.

MATCHED_PREREGISTRATION_POWER_AND_KILL_CRITERIA | Replay the first-known admissible vintage, enforcing event, observation, required finality and revision-availability cutoffs. On identical rows, compare it with a latest-vintage replay used only as a leakage diagnostic and with prespecified admissible observation delays. Report score and decision flips, coverage changes and changes in paired loss; report separately any changes from outcome revisions or newly recoverable rows. A gain visible only with later linkage, backfilled quotes, or worse feed quality in the baseline does not survive.

MATCHED_PREREGISTRATION_POWER_AND_KILL_CRITERIA | Before outcome access, set the minimum useful paired improvement and noninferiority margins for coverage and both error costs from the original owner's baseline and cost evidence, not from this packet. Estimate power from adverse-event incidence, paired switch counts, cluster variation and censoring; launch and snapshot counts are not effective N. Use purged chronological development and later independent holdout blocks, with a boundary that prevents label or lookback overlap and respects launch/pool/batch dependence. Use paired block uncertainty and account for multiple secondary comparisons. Kill the delta if it is duplicate or redundant, if adequate held-out evidence rules out useful improvement over a simpler matched baseline, or if the benefit fails the cost or coverage guardrails. A wide interval spanning both no effect and useful benefit is inconclusive, not a falsification. Historical replay alone is not prospective validation.

EXISTING_UI_READOUT_IF_INCREMENTAL | No UI delta now. If the ablation later survives independent review, test whether the existing paper timeline can explain raw eligible count versus conditional bounds, with the clock, source revision, freshness and explicit unknown/refusal reason. No index, identities, entry cue or live classification.

ORIGINAL_OWNER_DECISIVE_NEXT_ACTION_AND_DISPOSITION | The cheapest decisive check is original owner #1156's read-only comparison of the single width ablation with S3/S4 and the broader Astra/Navigator scopes before any replay. The review artifact is a qualification card, not a repository change: identify the unaddressed contrast and, only if it is distinct, the immutable public replay, as-of baseline, coverage and executable-outcome bindings that would make the test possible. Verified overlap means DEDUPED_TO_EXISTING_OWNER. Otherwise the trigger out of SOURCE_BLOCKED_WITH_TRIGGER is a distinct contrast plus those qualified public bindings; that would make it eligible only for forward-test preregistration review. Until then, stop. Nothing was built, dispatched or changed, so there is nothing to roll back. Strategist disposition was not adjudicated.
summary: VERDICT=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; MODEL_USED=gpt-6.2-sol; NO_CODE_WRITE_PERFORMED; NO_AUTHORITY_CHANGE; SOURCE_BLOCKED_WITH_TRIGGER. The reported negative follower simulations weigh against treating coordination as an entry signal; they do not test whether uncertainty about participation improves adverse-exit screening. No matched point-in-time decisions, mature executable outcomes or costs are supplied, so incremental value and both error costs are unknown. Keep no incremental value as the working null. Preserve only a conditional test of concentration-bound width beyond B2, with no build. The first gate is owner overlap; the empirical gate is a version-bound public replay with comparable baselines and executable outcome evidence.
uncertainties: UNKNOWN | No immutable row-level artifact in the packet establishes the launch denominator, actual knowledge-time inputs, historical program version and ordering, source gaps, or mature size-specific entry and exit outcomes. A1 artifact access, licensing and reproducibility are unverified.

UNKNOWN | Exact B0 replay, reproducible B1/B2 decisions, whether B2 already contains equivalent uncertainty information, private implementation or feature availability, and the current contents and overlap of pending specialist work. Supplied hashes and queue references do not verify those claims.

UNKNOWN | Decision divergence, both switch counts, false-positive and false-negative rates and costs, missed viable opportunities, calibration, and incremental discrimination or net value against B0, B1 or B2. The packet supplies no matched decisions, labels or cost rows from which to calculate them.

UNKNOWN | Knowledge-time and revision sensitivity, realistic size-specific cost, rates of censored or unobservable exits, effective sample size and statistical power. The negative mean reported for A1 cannot fill any of these gaps for the screening test.

UNKNOWN | Exact P0 deployment identity, the provider's undisclosed heat-score weighting, whether any individual launch used the product, and actual project model or release-gate state. No external, private or Round 3 evidence was accessed.
